_meta.description: Legs-only (12-joint) policy contract. kp/kd are the bench-tuned uniform sim<->real gains (see gains_source) written TO the ESCs; effort/Kt/gear/offset/limits are PULLED FROM the ESCs (device truth); default_pose/action_scale/obs match the deployed walk policy.
_meta.position_offsets_note: Re-pulled after power-up recalibration. position_offset resets each power cycle and must be recaptured per session.
_meta.STATUS: joint_order + obs layout + action_scale + default_pose CONFIRMED against humanoid-policy trainer; gains = uniform kp=45/kd=1.5 (2026-08-24 revert); effort/limits/gear = ESC device truth. starting_pose captured & clamped.
_meta.default_pose_source: WALK policy stand pose (humanoid-policy/deploy/walk/policy_latest.yaml default_joint_positions), device frame: right hip_roll/hip_yaw/ankle_roll negated from the URDF-mirrored export so both legs share sign. This is the pose the runner ramps to and uses as the walk action offset. See NEXT_STEPS.md step 1.
_meta.position_limits_source: URDF position_limits from humanoid_lite.json (ESC-read limits are offset-adjusted in firmware frame and drifted after recal — do NOT use for clamping)
_meta.gains_source: bench-tuned uniform kp=45 / kd=1.5 (humanoid-tuner); humanoid-policy 1fb90de plant + policy deployed at 6a6f171 (run 2026-08-18_20-45-17, model_5999). REVERTED to this on 2026-08-24 after the Berkeley-default kp=20/kd=2.0 A/B (humanoid-policy d2d031f) failed to stabilise on hardware where kp45 did. kp20 bundle archived at humanoid-policy/deploy/walk/archive/ ; kp45 bundle restored from deploy/walk/archive/2026-08-18_kp45-bench-tuned/.
_meta.effort_source: Motor-typed caps applied 2026-09-25 per docs/HARDWARE_PLAN_2026-09-23.md §1: 12.0 Nm on the 8 M6C12 joints (hip roll/yaw/pitch, knee), 7.0 Nm on the 4 MAD5010 ankles. Matches humanoid-policy deploy/walk/leg_policy_contract.json for the measA-full bundle. Also restored torque_constant to the 8/4 motor split (0.08958 / 0.06588) and raised current_limit to 20 A on left_hip_yaw and both ankle_roll, whose previous 10 A / 6 A made their configured torque limits physically unreachable.

observation.note: joint_pos fed relative to default_pose. base_ang_vel / projected_gravity come from the daemon's `base` telemetry block (external WitMotion IMU); the daemon only reads it when started with --imu-device, and reports base:null otherwise, in which case the runtime falls back to an upright stub ([0,0,-1], 0) and says so.

action.formula: clipped = clip(action, action_limit_lower, action_limit_upper); target = policy_frame_sign * (clipped * action_scale) + default_pose; then clamp to [position_limit_lower, position_limit_upper]. policy_frame_sign is -1 on right_hip_roll/right_hip_yaw/right_ankle_roll and +1 elsewhere: the trainer exports in the URDF frame, which is left/right mirrored, while default_pose and the limits here are DEVICE frame, which is not. prev_action stores `clipped`, pre-scale and unflipped, because that is what the trainer feeds back.
action.action_limit_source: humanoid-policy trainer export policies/walk/policy_latest.yaml (action_limit_lower/upper). The trainer clips pre-scale actions to this range during training; the runtime previously clipped at +/-100, letting the policy command targets far outside the trained range (observed |action| up to 10.17 on 2026-08-24).

joints.notes: Encoder broken: position_offset + live position unreliable. Mirror left_ankle_roll for base/starting pose.
